p: Covering more than 300 hectares, this is said to be the largest national forest park in northern China, with nine caves, twelve peaks and dozens of temples scattered across it. The best known peak is Tianzhu Peak (天柱峰; Tiānzhùfēng).
A karst cave some 600 m long, inside Mt. Shangfang park. Its main draw is a stalagmite about 37 m tall.
